# Multipart EOF finalizes the active child and closes its eligible decomposition stream

For an unfinished final multipart child, MimeMultipart_parse_eof now calls the child’s parse_eof and parse_end before the file-decomposition close callback. The same child-eligibility predicate gates normal init/output/close and EOF; it skips the exact display-container, multipart-child and external-vCard cases. The registered draft callback uses a nesting counter and closes its decoder/temporary stream at the outer close. The new malformed fixture test directly checks the full 4670-byte attachment and exact content after inline forwarding to its local SMTP daemon. This is source and fixture inspection, not a fresh test result or a guarantee for aborts, corrupt inputs, every decoder or file errors.

Scope: MIME draft and forward decomposition.
